name: dsh-plugin-updater
description: Startup update checks for installed DSH plugins, DSH Desktop and the core, with a draggable panel, live progress and one-click updates — no agent calls, no token spend.
author: TT10-24 (https://github.com/TT10-24)

description.zh: 上线时自动检查已安装插件、DSH 桌面端与内核版本；左侧可拖动面板提示，带实时进度、一键全部更新和重启按钮，全程不调用 agent、不消耗 token。
description.en: Checks installed plugins, DSH Desktop and the core on every launch. A draggable panel shows live progress, updates everything in one click and offers a restart button — no agent calls, no token spend.
